versions.changelog: Added support for the Better Armor Bar pack, and fixed a hand model issue on cross-platform servers.
Added support for the Debug HUD pack, and fixed a paperdoll rendering issue.
Added support for the Shiny Pots pack, including configurable item IDs.
Added support for the Waypoints+ pack. Fixed an intermittent issue affecting the FPS Counter.
Added support and configuration variables for the Death Coords and Better Hover Text packs.
Fixed an intermittent hand-rendering issue, and fixed the Clock & Compass HUD failing to render (requires Clock & Compass HUD v1.0.1 or later).
Added support for the Clock & Compass HUD pack. Resolved a range of visual issues, and added a variable to toggle the Level Calculator's visibility.
Added support for the Speedometer pack. Fixed an issue causing some zombie villagers to fail to load.

notice.title: A Must-Have for All Packs!
notice.intro: To ensure all your Pepe's Packs load and work perfectly, you must enable and place the Pepe's Pack Assets pack above all other packs in your load order.
notice.instruction: Download and Import it like a regular pack and make sure it's on top of the list.
notice.featuresTitle: What Does the Assets Pack Do?
notice.featuresIntro: This essential pack provides the core foundation for all other Pepe's Packs:

features.title: Seamless Compatibility
features.text: It makes every pack compatible with each other, ensuring they work together without issues.

features.title: Shared Resources
features.text: It contains crucial assets that multiple packs need, preventing duplication and keeping things tidy.

features.title: Full Customization
features.text: It allows you to easily configure settings across all your packs from one central place.

notice.critical: Your game will crash if the Pepe's Pack Assets isn't enabled! Don't forget to activate it!
